meta.title: Majlis Fund
meta.description: Local donation campaigns with an open ledger: orphan sponsorship, home renovation, medical aid — Local Council, Salamiyah

home.empty: There are no published campaigns in this category right now.
home.heroTitle: Salamiyah’s donations, with an account anyone can read
home.heroBody: The council runs campaigns for orphan sponsorship, home renovation and medical aid. Every lira is recorded: what was collected, what was spent and for whom — without revealing anyone’s identity.

steps.title: Pick a campaign
steps.body: Sponsorship, renovation or medical aid: each has its own target and account.

steps.title: Pay
steps.body: A transfer or local e-wallet with the receipt uploaded, or cash at a nearby collection point.

steps.title: We verify
steps.body: The finance verifier matches the amount, issues an official receipt and you are notified at once.

steps.title: We spend with proof
steps.body: Every payment out is recorded with an invoice or photo and shown on the campaign.

auth.donorHint: Donors can also use the mobile app.
auth.subtitle: For donors and council staff. Use your registered phone number.
auth.required: Enter your phone number and password.
auth.unavailable: The server could not be reached. Try again shortly.
auth.panelTitle: An open account for every donation
auth.panelBody: Orphan sponsorship, home renovation and medical aid: the council verifies every donation before it counts and documents every payment with proof.
panelPoints: A finance check on every donation

CASE_OFFICER.body: Publish an approved case with a summary that never reveals the beneficiary.

FINANCE_VERIFIER.body: Match receipts and collected cash, then issue the official receipt.

FINANCE_VERIFIER.title: Record spending
FINANCE_VERIFIER.body: Record every payment out of a campaign with its invoice or photo.
